phrases.2個のf64を下位2個のf32へ変換し、上位2レーンを0にする。: Convert two f64 lanes into the two lowest f32 lanes and zero the two upper lanes.
phrases.bの下位f64をaの下位f32へ変換し、aの上位3レーンを保持する。: Convert the lowest f64 lane from b to the lowest f32 lane in a; preserve the three upper lanes from a.
phrases.下位f64を符号付きi32へ変換する。: Convert the lowest f64 lane to signed i32.
phrases.2個のf64を下位2個のi32へ変換し、上位2レーンを0にする。: Convert two f64 lanes into the two lowest i32 lanes and zero the two upper lanes.
phrases.下位f64を符号付きi64へ変換する。: Convert the lowest f64 lane to signed i64.
phrases.符号付きi32をaの下位f32へ変換し、aの上位3レーンを保持する。: Convert signed i32 to the lowest f32 lane in a; preserve the three upper lanes from a.
phrases.4個の符号付きi32をレーンごとにf32へ変換する。: Convert four signed i32 lanes to f32, element by element.
phrases.符号付きi64をaの下位f64へ変換し、aの上位レーンを保持する。: Convert signed i64 to the lowest f64 lane in a; preserve the upper lane from a.
phrases.4個のf32の除算をレーンごとに行う。: Divide four f32 lanes element by element.
phrases.下位f32の除算を行い、aの上位3レーンを保持する。: Divide the lowest f32 lane and preserve the three upper lanes from a.
phrases.2個のf64の除算をレーンごとに行う。: Divide two f64 lanes element by element.
phrases.下位f64の除算を行い、aの上位1レーンを保持する。: Divide the lowest f64 lane and preserve the upper lane from a.
phrases.4個のf32の乗算をレーンごとに行う。: Multiply four f32 lanes element by element.
phrases.下位f32の乗算を行い、aの上位3レーンを保持する。: Multiply the lowest f32 lane and preserve the three upper lanes from a.
phrases.2個のf64の乗算をレーンごとに行う。: Multiply two f64 lanes element by element.
phrases.下位f64の乗算を行い、aの上位1レーンを保持する。: Multiply the lowest f64 lane and preserve the upper lane from a.
phrases.4個のf32の平方根をレーンごとに求める。: Compute the square root of four f32 lanes element by element.
phrases.下位f32の平方根を求め、aの上位3レーンを保持する。: Compute the square root of the lowest f32 lane and preserve the three upper lanes from a.
phrases.2個のf64の平方根をレーンごとに求める。: Compute the square root of two f64 lanes element by element.
phrases.下位f64の平方根を求め、aの上位1レーンを保持する。: Compute the square root of the lowest f64 lane and preserve the upper lane from a.
phrases.4個のf32の減算をレーンごとに行う。: Subtract four f32 lanes element by element.
phrases.下位f32の減算を行い、aの上位3レーンを保持する。: Subtract the lowest f32 lane and preserve the three upper lanes from a.
phrases.2個のf64の減算をレーンごとに行う。: Subtract two f64 lanes element by element.
phrases.下位f64の減算を行い、aの上位1レーンを保持する。: Subtract the lowest f64 lane and preserve the upper lane from a.
phrases.2個のf64の最小値をレーンごとに選ぶ。: Select the minimum of two f64 lanes element by element.
phrases.ARM native診断の追加対応。Python不一致30caseの内数ではない: Additional ARM native diagnostic coverage, separate from the 30 Python mismatch cases.
phrases.2個のf64の最大値をレーンごとに選ぶ。: Select the maximum of two f64 lanes element by element.
phrases.公式データのdate属性をそのまま保存。: The date attribute is preserved from the official data.
phrases.公式caseのIntel binding名と公式offline Guideのin: Match each official case Intel binding against an intrinsic in the official offline Guide. ISA comes from CPUID; header, prototype, and instructions are taken from the Guide data.
phrases.case IDのsse2接頭辞とrequired_isa=sse2はフレームワー: The sse2 case-ID prefix and required_isa=sse2 specify the minimum framework execution profile. They differ from individual Guide ISA labels; for example, _mm_add_ps is SSE.
phrases.Guideは操作とAPIの対応元。NaN符号・payloadの全期待bitをGu: The Guide maps operations to APIs. Complete expected NaN sign and payload bits are not derived from the Guide alone; recorded strict SSE2 results under Rosetta provide separate evidence.
phrases.prototypeはGuideのAPI宣言であり、framework caseの: The prototype is the Guide API declaration, not the direct framework case signature. In particular, unary sqrt.f64x2.scalar is restricted to _mm_sqrt_sd(a,a).
phrases.summary_jaは短い独自の説明。Guideのdescriptionとope: summary_ja contains short independently written descriptions. Full Guide description and operation text is not included.
phrases.GuideのCPUIDとframework_required_isaは別の項目。: Guide CPUID and framework_required_isa are separate fields. The API index follows official case Intel symbols and does not prove CPU execution or equivalence.
phrases.一致側の操作を説明する代表入力。2159件の不一致集計には含めない。: A representative matching input illustrating the operation. It is not included in the 2,159 mismatch count.
phrases.NaN の符号を調べる分類です。Python float を経由する演算と、SS: This category examines NaN signs. Compare operations routed through Python float with the NaN encoding generated by invalid SSE2 arithmetic. Use each lane XOR to determine whether only the sign differs.
phrases.複数の NaN 入力がある場合の payload 選択と quiet 化を調べる: This category examines payload selection and quieting when several NaN inputs are present. Inspect input order and the conversion and arithmetic paths through Python float. Under a bit_exact contract, NaNs with different signs, quiet bits, or payloads are mismatches.
phrases.算術モデルの float_binary_case を確認する分類です。Pytho: Inspect the float_binary_case arithmetic model. Alongside Python float operations, division has an integer-based nearest-even path through _divide_float_bits and _round_ratio_even. Compare the stored rounding request with each implementation path. These cases include halfway values, cancellation, and subnormal boundaries; do not infer one root cause for all findings.
phrases.sqrt_case の math.sqrt() → _float_to_bits: Inspect the sqrt_case path from math.sqrt() to _float_to_bits. Compare the recorded rounding request with intermediate square-root computation and final conversion. A difference in the least significant XOR bit alone does not establish the cause.
phrases.conversion_case / _float_to_integer の ro: Inspect round() and math.trunc() in conversion_case and _float_to_integer. Check the requested rounding direction, integer overflow handling, and the SSE2 indefinite result alongside the input.
phrases.conversion_case / scalar_conversion_case: Inspect the integer-based nearest-even conversion through conversion_case or scalar_conversion_case to _f64_to_f32. Check rounding at precision loss, overflow, and the normal/subnormal boundary. The displayed differences are observations, not predictions of results after a fix.

Inspect integer-to-float conversion in conversion_case and scalar_conversion_case. Some paths use integer-based nearest-even conversion in _i32_to_f32; others use float() and struct. At precision boundaries where an integer is not exactly representable, compare the requested rounding direction with the observed result.
phrases.符号付きゼロ、無限大、無効演算の境界をまとめた検証分類です。ゼロの符号の差と、無: This category covers signed zero, infinity, and invalid arithmetic. Distinguish zero-sign differences from NaNs produced by invalid operations. The category name alone does not establish a shared root cause.
phrases.最も近い表現へ丸め、ちょうど中間なら末尾が偶数の表現を選ぶ: Round to the nearest representable value; exact ties choose an even least significant bit
phrases.下方向（−∞側）へ丸める。負数でも絶対値を小さくする方向とは限らない: Round downward toward negative infinity, which can increase the magnitude of a negative value
phrases.ゼロ方向へ丸める（絶対値を増やさない）: Round toward zero without increasing the magnitude
phrases.上位64bitへメモリを読み込み、下位64bitは保持する。: Load the upper 64 bits from memory and preserve the other half.
phrases.下位64bitへメモリを読み込み、上位64bitは保持する。: Load the lower 64 bits from memory and preserve the other half.
phrases.上位64bitをメモリへ書き込む。: Store the upper 64 bits to memory.
phrases.下位64bitをメモリへ書き込む。: Store the lower 64 bits to memory.
phrases.Intel の実命令と SIMDe の戻り値をビット単位で比較します。未対応 C: Compare actual Intel intrinsics against SIMDe return bytes. Unsupported CPU features, compilation failures, and execution failures remain not comparable. Candidate counts are not verified conformance counts.
phrases.Intel の実命令と移植実装の戻り値をビット単位で比較します。未対応 CPU・: Compare actual Intel intrinsics against portable implementation return bytes. Unsupported CPU features, compilation failures, and execution failures remain not comparable. Candidate counts are not verified conformance counts.

patterns.source: (?P<source>a|b|value)のレーン(?P<lane>\d+)：(?P<value>.*?)を(?P<source_type>[fiu]\d+)から(?P<target_type>[fiu]\d+)へ数値変換。
計算するのはレーン0だけ。レーン1〜(?P<last>\d+)はaの元のビット列を保ちます。
patterns.target: Compute only lane 0. Preserve original bits from a in lanes 1–\g<last>.

patterns.source: 平方根を計算するのはレーン0だけ。レーン1〜(?P<last>\d+)はaのビット列を保ちます。
patterns.target: Compute the square root only in lane 0. Preserve bits from a in lanes 1–\g<last>.

patterns.source: 変換結果で戻り値のレーン0だけを置き換え、上位レーン1〜(?P<last>\d+)はaのビット列を保ちます。
patterns.target: Replace only return lane 0 with the converted result. Preserve bits from a in lanes 1–\g<last>.

patterns.source: 変換した(?P<count>\d+)レーンより上の戻り値レーンは0で埋めます。
patterns.target: Zero all return lanes above the \g<count> converted lanes.

patterns.source: 各レーンの2入力に対して(?P<operation>.*?)を行い、返す要素型で表現します。
patterns.target: Apply \g<operation> to the two inputs in each lane and represent the result in the return element type.

patterns.source: (?P<source_type>[fiu]\d+)の数値を(?P<target_type>[fiu]\d+)で表します。ビット列を読み替えるcastとは別の操作です。
patterns.target: Represent a \g<source_type> value as \g<target_type>. This is numeric conversion, distinct from reinterpreting a bit pattern.

patterns.source: Intel Intrinsics を (?P<target>[^<>\n]+?) に移植した C 実装が、Intel を基準とするケース契約を満たすか検証しています。
patterns.target: Verify the C implementation of Intel Intrinsics for \g<target> against the Intel reference case contract.

patterns.source: 実行エラー (?P<errors>[0-9,]+)件 ／ unsupported (?P<unsupported>[0-9,]+)件 ／ invalid input (?P<invalid>[0-9,]+)件。結果の一致・不一致とは分けて集計しています。
patterns.target: Execution errors: \g<errors> / unsupported: \g<unsupported> / invalid input: \g<invalid>. These are counted separately from output agreement.

patterns.source: 一致 (?P<matched>[0-9,]+)件 ／ 不一致 (?P<mismatched>[0-9,]+)件 ／ 比較不能 (?P<unknown>[0-9,]+)件。\s*不一致には出力値の差と実行ステータスの差が含まれます。
patterns.target: Matched: \g<matched> / mismatched: \g<mismatched> / not comparable: \g<unknown>. Mismatches include differences in output values and execution statuses.

patterns.source: 保存した比較詳細 (?P<count>[0-9,]+)件。Intel baseline と対象の実測値をそのまま表示します。
patterns.target: Saved comparison details: \g<count>. Intel baseline and target observations are shown as recorded.

patterns.source: 観測値に差がある全 (?P<total>[0-9,]+)件のうち先頭 (?P<count>[0-9,]+)件を表示します。契約による許容差を含み、未適合の総数は集計欄に表示します。
patterns.target: Showing the first \g<count> of \g<total> inputs with different observations, including differences permitted by the contract. The summary gives the total nonconformance count.

patterns.source: 全 (?P<count>[0-9,]+)件の未適合・比較不能な入力と実測値をダウンロード（JSONL）
patterns.target: Download all \g<count> nonconforming or noncomparable inputs and observations (JSONL)
